maria-cs: Heads-up — AtlasHealth go-live is tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need final SLO acceptance from SRE + the customer-facing credits/playbook we can send if anything goes wrong.

oliver-pm: Can we confirm the exact SLO numbers they signed? I have two docs floating.

maria-cs: Signed in contract: 99.9% availability monthly, p95 latency <= 350ms for generation endpoints. They specifically asked for clarity on credit calc and evidence required.

ev an-sre: (evan-sre) I'll validate current telemetry and draft the ops playbook. Quick note: our current p95 for AtlasHealth test workload is ~280-300ms on hosted. Availability last 30d = 99.95.

sam-sales: Customer asked for an explicit policy they can share with procurement. Also worried about renewal if they see any ambiguity in credits.

ev an-sre: Draft runbook snippet below — please read and tell me if it's shareable as-is.

evan-sre: ```SLO SUMMARY
- Availability SLO: >= 99.9% monthly
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 350ms (gen endpoints)

EVIDENCE REQUIRED FOR CREDITS
1) Service outage windows from metrics backend (start/end)
2) Request-level logs showing increased error rates and traces
3) Affected routes/models and customer request IDs (where possible)

CREDIT CALCULATION (high-level)
- Minor breach (>= 99.0% & < 99.9%): credit = 10% of monthly service fee
- Major breach (< 99.0%): credit = 25% of monthly service fee
- Latency degradations: credits applied only if p95 breach sustained > 12 hours and matching error uplift

Escalation: tag @evan-sre, @oncall to open incident and notify CS lead.```

maria-cs: That looks good. Two asks: 1) include what telemetry export the customer needs to accept the evidence (we should give them a CSV/JSON schema or Grafana dashboard link), 2) add a short paragraph about how we handle partial-month credits for onboarding customers.

evan-sre: Good call. Adding schema and partial-month wording. Also adding a short sample of the telemetry snippet so procurement can validate.

evan-sre: ```SAMPLE METRICS EXPORT (CSV headers)
timestamp,route,model,request_id,status_code,latency_ms,region
2026-03-18T08:12:01Z,/generate/gpt-4o,redwood-12345,req-8a7b,200,302,us-west-2
2026-03-18T08:12:05Z,/generate/gpt-4o,redwood-12346,req-8a7c,503,120,us-west-2
```

sam-sales: Can we put the credit calc into plain english for the customer email? Also want a one-paragraph assurance for procurement about evidence handling and privacy.

oliver-pm: I'll draft the procurement paragraph: short, non-legal, confirms we only share request IDs and aggregated metrics unless customer signs a DPA amendment for payload-level logs.

maria-cs: Ops playbook items we need to finalize before sending to customer:
- Final SLO wording (contract exact)
- Evidence schema & Grafana link
- Credit calc plain english + examples
- Onboarding partial-month pro-rata formula
- Single point of contact for incidents (CS lead + SRE oncall)

evan-sre: Minor flag — if a model hot-restart caused higher latency we should exclude that first 15m window from credit calc if we performed immediate mitigation and notified the customer. Add that exception.

maria-cs: Agree. Add a short clause: "mitigation window" up to 30 minutes for automated restarts, 15 minutes for manual restarts — we document actions and exclude from creditable downtime if communicated within 1 hour.

sam-sales: Customer also asked for a 60-min enablement walkthrough on Monday after go-live — can we schedule CS + SRE to join? Procurement wants the recorded session.

oliver-pm: I'll block 60 minutes in calendar and include a brief deck (SLOs, how to read dashboards, credit request process).

maria-cs: Action items: 
- evan-sre: final ops playbook + sample CSV + mitigation clause (due EOD today)
- oliver-pm: procurement paragraph + enablement deck (due tomorrow morning)
- sam-sales: confirm customer available window for the recorded enablement (pinged them)
- maria-cs: prepare customer-facing email and send after approvals

evan-sre: Working on playbook now, will ping when ready.

sam-sales: Customer confirmed Tue 11:00 PDT for the walkthrough. I told them we'll send the playbook beforehand.

maria-cs: Thanks team. Once playbook + deck ready I'll run final copy and send. If anything looks risky for renewal we'll escalate to head of CS. :white_check_mark:

oliver-pm: Looks good. One more ask — include a short example credit calculation with numbers (monthly invoice $40k -> minor breach credit = $4k). That helps procurement sanity-check.

maria-cs: Added to the deck notes. Closing thread — will post the final PDF here when done.
